meta.name: sample-wave
meta.description: Canonical 3-issue sample wave for the wave-orchestrator e2e replay (issue #381). Synthesized: no archived wave-state-archived-*.json exists in the repo. Encodes one clean wave (3 issues, no planner-level file/label conflicts), a count-line rebase episode (issues #401 and #402 both edit the AGENTS.md test-count line that the planner's issue-text extraction cannot see), and one mid-write corruption + resume episode (the 2026-08-20 failure mode).

issues.title: Add metrics histogram for soft-stop latency
issues.body:
## Context

The soft-stop path emits no latency signal.

## Fix

Add a Prometheus histogram in `src/openstudio_operator/metrics.py` and cover it in `tests/test_metrics_endpoint.py`.

## Acceptance criterion

- The histogram family appears in the /metrics inventory.
- Tests pass: `tests/test_metrics_endpoint.py`

issues.title: Document the worker recycle grace period
issues.body:
## Context

The recycle grace period is undocumented.

## Fix

Add a runbook section to `docs/onboarding.md` describing the anchor semantics, with a smoke assertion against `tests/test_worker_recycler.py`.

## Acceptance criterion

- The runbook section exists and matches the handler behavior.

issues.title: Harden redis client against URL rewrite
issues.body:
## Context

A mutated `spec.redisUrl` can leak a stale connection.

## Fix

Rebuild the connection on URL change in `src/openstudio_operator/redis_client.py` and extend `tests/test_redis_client.py`.

## Acceptance criterion

- A URL mutation invalidates the cached client.
